gloss: good results; excellent performance; strong record

definitions.gloss: good results; excellent performance; strong showing
definitions.explanation: Outstanding or better-than-expected results in academics, sports, business, or other measurable endeavors.

examples.japanese: {好成績|こうせいせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収|おさ}めた→収める：02022_osameru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{好成績|こうせいせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}した→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: He posted a strong performance at the tournament.

examples.english: This season, I aim to maintain good results and win the championship.

notes:
Composed of {好|こう} (good, favorable) and ⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧ (results, grades, performance). The prefix {好|こう} elevates the base word to indicate above-average or praiseworthy outcomes.

Used across academic, athletic, and business contexts. In academics, it refers to good grades or exam scores; in sports, to strong placements or records; in business, to favorable sales figures or performance metrics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {好成績|こうせいせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収|おさ}める→収める：02022_osameru⟧: to achieve good results
- {好成績|こうせいせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧: to leave behind a strong record
- {好成績|こうせいせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to get good grades
- {好成績|こうせいせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{維持|いじ}する→維持する：17311_ijisuru⟧: to maintain good results
- {好成績|こうせいせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to produce good results

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧: results, grades — the neutral base word without the positive connotation
- {好結果|こうけっか}: good outcome — focuses on the end result rather than measurable performance
- ⟦{優秀|ゆうしゅう}→優秀：03646_yuushuu⟧な⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧: outstanding grades — uses an adjective rather than a compound noun
